sampling: step 1, every step divisible by 10 and the first step of every epoch, from each run's progress.jsonl (one line per optimiser step)

fields.loss: the total loss, DINO's global term plus lambda (1.0) times the contrastive term
fields.global_loss: DINO's global term: the cross-entropy between teacher and student class outputs
fields.con_loss: the contrastive term: the sum of the ten views' InfoNCE terms divided by ten
fields.con_pos_from_threshold_share: the share of the positive pairs that lie beyond their anchor's top k
fields.con_neg_share_mean: the negatives' mean share of an InfoNCE denominator
fields.con_margin_mean: the mean of s_ip minus the anchor's largest negative similarity
fields.teacher_momentum: the EMA momentum of the teacher
fields.teacher_entropy: diagnostics: the entropy of the teacher's class distribution on the global crops
fields.teacher_student_kl: diagnostics: the KL divergence from the teacher's to the student's class distribution
fields.patch_target_entropy: diagnostics: SelfPatch's patch target entropy (null on the contrastive path)
fields.con_window_share: the share of the positive pairs inside the anchor's wrapped 3 x 3 window
fields.con_cap_cuts_pos: anchors whose positives the cap of 24 cut
fields.con_cap_cuts_neg: anchors whose negatives the cap of 48 cut
fields.gradient_total_preclip_norm: the gradient's total norm before clipping
fields.backbone_frozen: true while the backbone is frozen (epoch 0)

runs_described.con1: run 1: the rule from the released SelfPatch start
runs_described.con2: run 2: the rule from the DINO start
runs_described.con3: run 3: the rule through the projection head, from the released start
